parts:
Is it possible to compare non-nested WLSMV models in R

As far as I know, only by comparing incremental fit indices (e.g., CFI or TLI).  But this requires that you use a baseline model that is nested within each competing hypothesized model.

http://dx.doi.org/10.1037/1082-989X.8.1.16
